data.intent: Unit tests for Metric 2 over the default 2013-2026 bookends

decisions.chosen: World Bank GDP per person employed and GDP per capita, world aggregate, real
decisions.detail: user: productivity measured by actual economic indexes (GDP per capita) for the whole world, economic data only
user: bookended by the GTA V and GTA 6 releases (17 Sep 2013, 19 Nov 2026)

decisions.decision: Years the World Bank has not published
decisions.chosen: per capita carried by IMF WEO world real GDP growth less latest World Bank population growth, flagged is_estimate; per worker left NULL
decisions.detail: the IMF WEO is the standard published source for the current year; no free published world employment growth to carry output per worker

fct_world_productivity.content:
name: fct_world_productivity
description: 'Metric 2, GTA V to GTA 6: world productivity per year from 2013 to 2026 and its real change since GTA V''s launch year. One row per measure per year. Population: Every year from var gta_v_year (2013) to var gta_6_year (2026) for both measures, published or not; an unpublished, unestimated year keeps its row with a NULL value.'
model: ref('fct_world_productivity')
defaults:
  agg_time_dimension: year_start
entities:
  - name: world_productivity_key
    type: primary
    expr: world_productivity_key
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
dimensions:
  - name: measure
    type: categorical
    description: output_per_worker or output_per_person.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: data_year
    type: categorical
    description: Calendar year the value describes.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: year_start
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    description: '1 January of data_year: the time axis.'
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: launch
    type: categorical
    description: GTA V on 2013, GTA 6 on 2026, NULL in between.
measures:
  - name: value
    agg: max
    expr: value
    description: Real output in the measure's unit.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: see unit column
          null_rule: 'NULL when unpublished and not estimated: unavailable, never zero.'
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: pct_change_since_gta_v
    agg: max
    expr: pct_change_since_gta_v
    description: Real change since GTA V's launch year, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          null_rule: NULL when the year's value is unavailable.
          additivity: non_additive
config:
  meta:
    dex:
      population:
        rule: Every year from var gta_v_year (2013) to var gta_6_year (2026) for both measures, published or not; an unpublished, unestimated year keeps its row with a NULL value.
      assumptions:
        - decision: Measures of productivity
          chosen: World Bank GDP per person employed and GDP per capita, world aggregate, real
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: productivity measured by actual economic indexes (GDP per capita) for the whole world, economic data only'
          column: measure
        - decision: Years covered
          chosen: 2013 to 2026, every year
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: bookended by the GTA V and GTA 6 releases (17 Sep 2013, 19 Nov 2026)'
          column: data_year
        - decision: Years the World Bank has not published
          chosen: per capita carried by IMF WEO world real GDP growth less latest World Bank population growth, flagged is_estimate; per worker left NULL
          evidence: default
          detail: the IMF WEO is the standard published source for the current year; no free published world employment growth to carry output per worker
          column: value
fct_world_productivity.reason: fct_world_productivity already has a semantic model ('fct_world_productivity' in models/marts/fct_world_productivity_semantic.yml); an authored definition is not overwritten or duplicated
notes: year_start: its type could not be read, so it is given day granularity, which a date or a timestamp both support
key column descriptions are not carried onto entities: MetricFlow's schema has no description field for an entity
not derived (role key or attribute, which a semantic model has no element for): unit, source_indicator, is_estimate, is_latest
metrics are not derived: a measure is what a column holds, a metric is a business definition, and that stays the author's
